# Önder Yıldırım

> Önder Yıldırım (Necmettin Önder Yıldırım) is a licensed attorney at the Istanbul Bar and a full-stack software architect and AI engineer in Istanbul, Turkey. He has practiced at Yıldırım & Yurdaöl Law Office since 2006, has worked in software for more than 20 years, and is the founder of Bluetree. His latest project (2026) is SignLens Trainer Studio.

The portfolio UI is one URL with English, Turkish, and French copy. English is the default HTML. This file is the factual summary. Do not invent clients, awards, or model-accuracy percentages; none are published here. SignLens source code is private and is not linked.

## Identity

- Name: Önder Yıldırım. Full name used on the site: Necmettin Önder Yıldırım.
- Location: Istanbul, Turkey.
- Law: licensed attorney, Istanbul Bar Association, Yıldırım & Yurdaöl Law Office, since 2006. Practice includes commercial and corporate law, intellectual property, transport and logistics, labor law, enforcement and bankruptcy, family law, traffic law, and cross-border advisory.
- Software: full-stack software architect and AI engineer. More than 20 years in software. Crypto and blockchain software from 2014 (engineer, then architect). Founder and lead architect of Bluetree since 2024.
- Languages: Turkish, English, and French. Programming languages used on the site: TypeScript, Python, Go, Java, and PHP.
- Education: LL.B., Eastern Mediterranean University, Cyprus, 2000–2004. Associate degree, Software Department, Istanbul University, 2023–2025, High Honor Student (Onur Öğrencisi). Ankara Tevfik Fikret High School.
- Contact: ondery777@gmail.com

## Expertise

- Legal technology, document systems, UYAP, and compliance-aware software
- AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), LangGraph, and the Model Context Protocol (MCP)
- Full-stack architecture: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js, Python, PostgreSQL, Prisma
- Computer vision training for traffic signs (YOLO, Ultralytics, CUDA PyTorch, Core ML export)
- Cryptocurrency and blockchain systems

## Projects

- [SignLens Trainer Studio](https://ondery.github.io/ondery/trainer-studio/): local, browser-based YOLO training studio for SignLens, an offline traffic-sign reader for iOS and Android. Python web app at 127.0.0.1, launched by a .bat file on Windows 11, tuned for a 6 GB RTX 3060 laptop GPU. Simple mode is a five-step plain-Turkish wizard. Reported accuracy is mAP50 read from results.csv. The iPhone step writes ios/signlens.pt; Codemagic converts it to Core ML. Tested with pytest.
- [Bluetree](https://github.com/bluetreetr): legal AI platform he founded (formerly LawToolsAI). Next.js, LangGraph, RAG, MCP, UYAP integration, document editing.
- [Quick Translator](https://github.com/ondery/quick-translator): open-source Chrome extension that translates selected text and pages in place, with text-to-speech.
